<?php
class Token53 {
    public function __destruct() { echo "D53\n"; }
}
function Park53($token) {
    echo "B53\n";
    $received = Fiber::suspend("pause53");
    echo "R53\n";
    var_dump($received);
    yield "cache53";
    echo "E53\n";
    return "return53";
}
$token = new Token53();
$weak = WeakReference::create($token);
$g = Park53($token);
unset($token);
$f = new Fiber(function () use ($g) {
    echo "F53\n";
    var_dump($g->current());
    echo "C53\n";
    return "fiber53";
});
var_dump($f->start());
var_dump($f->isSuspended(), $weak->get() !== null);
try {
    $g->next();
} catch (Throwable $error) {
    echo "REENTRY53\n";
    echo get_class($error), "|", $error->getMessage(), "\n";
    var_dump($error->getPrevious() === null);
}
var_dump($f->resume("sent53"));
var_dump($f->isTerminated(), $f->getReturn());
var_dump($g->current(), $weak->get() !== null);
$g->next();
var_dump($g->getReturn(), $weak->get() === null);
unset($g, $f, $weak);
echo "END53\n";

<?php
class Token53 {
    public function __destruct() { echo "D53\n"; }
}
function Park53($token) {
    echo "B53\n";
    yield "first53";
    echo "A53\n";
    $received = Fiber::suspend("pause53");
    echo "R53\n";
    var_dump($received);
    yield "cache53";
    echo "E53\n";
    return "return53";
}
$token = new Token53();
$weak = WeakReference::create($token);
$g = Park53($token);
unset($token);
$g->rewind();
$f = new Fiber(function () use ($g) {
    echo "F53\n";
    var_dump($g->next());
    var_dump($g->current());
    echo "C53\n";
    return "fiber53";
});
var_dump($f->start());
var_dump($f->isSuspended(), $weak->get() !== null);
try {
    $g->next();
} catch (Throwable $error) {
    echo "REENTRY53\n";
    echo get_class($error), "|", $error->getMessage(), "\n";
    var_dump($error->getPrevious() === null);
}
var_dump($f->resume("sent53"));
var_dump($f->isTerminated(), $f->getReturn());
var_dump($g->current(), $weak->get() !== null);
$g->next();
var_dump($g->getReturn(), $weak->get() === null);
unset($g, $f, $weak);
echo "END53\n";
